about_the_game:
Musicasa is a retro-styled sandbox about creativity, sound, and cozy spaces. Turn your desk into a living music studio. 

Build your own home studio by unboxing synths, drum machines, samplers, and quirky sound toys inspired by real gear. Arrange them however you like, connect them with cables, and start shaping your personal soundscape.

There are no wrong notes, just experiments waiting to happen. Try out different setups, discover unique combinations of instruments and effects, and see where your curiosity takes you. Whether you’re layering beats, designing dreamy ambient textures, or just playing around, the music you make is entirely your own.

Musicasa is about slowing down, tinkering, and enjoying the process of making music. Build your symphony one note at a time, and turn your room into the instrument.

Game Features

  • Unbox & collect instruments: From retro synths to drum boxes, each with their own personality.

  • Connect with cables: Patch together devices and effects to create new sounds.

  • Arrange your space: Place gear on your desk, move things around, and design your own cozy studio.

  • Create without pressure: Relax and experiment at your own pace, there’s no right way to play.

  • Retro pixel art: A warm, nostalgic aesthetic that makes your studio feel alive.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: x64 1.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or Later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
